scan: pdvd smx7, the blind re-judge of doc 89's (b1) missed stoppers plus controls (doc pdvd/90)

039349_71/37.html:
smx7 — does this muon stop inside the detector? (doc pdvd/89 §9, a blind re-judge)
Today's production does not call it a stopper (is_stm 0) and finds no Michel; it rejects the end on no_bragg (the dQ/dx at the end does not rise enough above the muon's plateau); shape_flat (the dQ/dx shape near the end fits a flat MIP profile better than a Bragg peak). Judge the muon, not the chain.
Please judge from the picture (3-D view, measurement tab, dQ/dx panel):
1. The verdict (one button; the click saves the row)
  • STM + MICHEL — the muon stops inside the detector and an electron starts at its end. Then set the Michel radio to attached, detached dots or both.
  • STM, no Michel — the muon stops, but you see no Michel.
  • THRU — the muon does not stop here: it goes on, or leaves through a wall, the cathode or a dead region.
  • FRAG → … if this cluster is only part of the muon (give the whole muon's verdict); MESSY if it is not one track; UNCLEAR if you cannot tell.
2. The pin: if the muon stops but its true end is not where the fit ends (the fit runs on past the Bragg peak, or stops short of it), move the pin to the true end and press SAVE this item.
3. Notes (optional): anything that decided it, e.g. “Bragg peak 4 cm before the fit end”, “exits the cathode”. Then next unlabelled >>.

Today's production does not call it a stopper (is_stm 0) and finds no Michel; it rejects the end on no_bragg (the dQ/dx at the end does not rise enough above the muon's plateau); shape_flat (the dQ/dx shape near the end fits a flat MIP profile better than a Bragg peak). Judge the muon, not the chain.
Please judge from the picture (3-D view, measurement tab, dQ/dx panel):
1. The verdict (one button; the click saves the row)
  • STM + MICHEL — the muon stops inside the detector and an electron starts at its end. Then set the Michel radio to attached, detached dots or both.
  • STM, no Michel — the muon stops, but you see no Michel.
  • THRU — the muon does not stop here: it goes on, or leaves through a wall, the cathode or a dead region.
  • FRAG → … if this cluster is only part of the muon (give the whole muon's verdict); MESSY if it is not one track; UNCLEAR if you cannot tell.
2. The pin: if the muon stops but its true end is not where the fit ends (the fit runs on past the Bragg peak, or stops short of it), move the pin to the true end and press SAVE this item.
3. Notes (optional): anything that decided it, e.g. “Bragg peak 4 cm before the fit end”, “exits the cathode”. Then next unlabelled >>.
